headline: Four executives categorized as Senior Management Personnel following promotions
why: Routine internal senior management promotions of existing long-term employees, unlikely to shift the stock price.

people.background: Over four decades of experience across the power sector spanning thermal power project design, EPC execution, and operations. Joined L&T in 2010.
